intuition.title: Nickel route interpretation
intuition.summary: The authors propose an OA-mediated reduction of Ni(II) to Ni metal followed by sulfur-driven conversion to cubic Ni3S4. The Superhydride route is described as a mechanistic test; it is not a time-resolved mechanism.
intuition.scope: Authors’ main-article interpretation, not a time-resolved mechanism or direct ligand-occupancy measurement.

general_background.title: A thiol can affect both precursor and surface
general_background.summary: A water-compatible thiol can bind precursor metal in solution and the metal-rich sites on a growing chalcogenide surface. Because these processes share the same ligand, acidity can jointly affect the growth rate and the coating that remains on the nanocrystal.
